requirements: Cancellation Policy: Cancellations must be made 14 days in advance to receive a deposit refund.
checkin: THANK YOU FOR CHOOSING SOUND BOUND FISHING FLEET! Please note we leave the dock on time. You must arrive at least 20 minutes before sail time. Allow for traffic, parking and check in. Please do not call the office to ask to hold the boat. We cannot as there are many other passengers on board. If you miss the boat you will be charged full fare. No exceptions.
cancellation: This transaction secures your spot aboard your trip, your card is not processed. Upon boarding the vessel you have the choice to pay in cash or pay by card! If you need to cancel or change your reservation please call the office. You may cancel up to 48 hours prior to a trip so we have time to fill your spot, if less than 48 hours card will be charged for a full fare, NO EXCEPTIONS.
